Write a list of different ways people ask for one thing about packages and mail (letters, parcels, the mailbox, signing for things). First write one line saying plainly what they want. Then write 6 to 10 ways to ask for it, one per line, from short and casual to long and polite. Most ways should not repeat the words of the first line.
Use the noun "recycling", the verb "need" and the adjective "early" somewhere (any form of them is fine, like a plural or the past tense). Spell these three words correctly. They can go in the first line; every way to ask must be something a real person would really say.
Include a request typed in a hurry, in lowercase with one small typo.
Use simple, everyday English. Write only the text itself: no title, no notes, and no angle brackets.

name: the tool's name in snake_case

people say:
